name: Six Robblees' Inc
old_description: Six Robblees' is your one-stop source for truck, trailer and tire shop supplies. It’s nice to know you have a partner who has been by your side since 1913. We look forward to serving you for the next 100 years!
about:
Six Robblees' Inc. traces its roots to 1913 when three brothers—Jim, Bill, and Herb Robblee—founded J.A. Robblee & Co. in Tacoma, Washington. The firm began as a bicycle repair shop before transitioning to racing car wheel work after World War I. By 1920 a second location opened in Seattle, and in 1930 the company was renamed Six Robblees' Inc. after Jim Robblee willed his share to his six remaining brothers. Today the business remains family-owned and is headquartered in Twin Falls, Idaho.

The company operates as a warehouse distributor of truck, trailer, and RV parts, as well as tire shop supplies and equipment. It stocks over 40,000 part numbers across 22 branches spanning eight states (Alaska, Montana, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Wyoming, California, and others). The network grew through acquisitions such as Union Rubber Company, Motor Wheel and Parts, and several Alaska-based firms. The distributor offers online account management and credit terms to its customers.

Six Robblees' serves the heavy-truck, light-truck, trailer, recreational vehicle, and tire-service sectors. Its customer base includes commercial fleets, independent repair shops, tire dealers, and RV service centers. The product range covers air brake components, axle and suspension parts, electrical wiring, exhaust components, fifth-wheel parts, hose assemblies, and a full line of tire service tools and TPMS accessories.

The business was built on the brothers' mechanical expertise and a focus on wheel-related products. Leadership has emphasized steady expansion through strategic purchases and membership in buying groups such as Heavy Duty America and Ascot Tire Supply to maintain a broad inventory and competitive pricing.

name: Skyline Furniture Mfg. Inc.
old_description: In the grand scheme of the furniture industry, there are very few brands that manufacture in the United States, particularly outside of North Carolina. There are even fewer that are run by female executives. But that’s what makes Meganne Wecker a true unicorn. She is the president and chief creative officer of Skyline Furniture Manufacturing, which is a brand founded by her grandfather.
about:
Skyline Furniture Mfg. Inc. operates from Thornton, Illinois, in the Chicago metropolitan area. The company was founded in 1946 by Norman Wecker, who launched a small factory in Chicago's south suburbs after returning from World War II. Ownership remains with the Wecker family, now in its third generation, with Norman's granddaughter Meganne Wecker serving as president and chief creative officer.

The company produces custom upholstered furniture for bedrooms, dining rooms, living rooms, and offices. Every piece is made to order in its Illinois facility, with fabrics and finishes that customers can customize from an extensive in-house textile library. Since 2016, Skyline has printed its own textiles digitally on site, integrating that capability into an e-commerce-driven supply chain designed for quick turnaround on custom orders. The operation blends traditional handcrafted upholstery with modern manufacturing technology, sourcing materials from across the United States.

Skyline sells primarily to retailers, interior designers, and e-commerce platforms that carry its brand to consumers nationwide. Its products appear in major online and brick-and-mortar retail channels, and the company has been featured in Forbes, Furniture Today, and The New York Times for its innovative approach to furniture customization.

The business distinguishes itself through a combination of fashion-forward design, in-house digital printing, and a family-culture philosophy that treats employees, suppliers, and customers as extended family. Meganne Wecker's leadership has pushed the company into e-commerce and digital manufacturing while maintaining the craftsmanship legacy established by her grandfather.

about:
SMT Manufacturing Group LLC operates from Hallam, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 2001 by Mark Gingalewski, who serves as managing partner. The company describes itself as a small business focused on contract electronic assembly for commercial and military customers, with a mission to become the primary contract manufacturer of choice.

The facility specializes in fine-pitch surface mount assembly, through-hole assembly, and complete box-build integration, supported by automated optical and X-ray inspection, RoHS-compliant processing, and in-house programming of AVR, PIC, and development boards. The shop is structured for small-batch, quick-turn work, typically handling runs under 1,000 units with a two-week average turnaround.

Customers span commercial and military sectors, with the company highlighting its ability to manage both electrical design and test requirements. The staff includes IPC-certified instructors and adheres to IPC-610/620 Class 3 and J-STD-001 standards, supported by an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Gingalewski, a BSEE graduate with over 20 years in military electronics before co-founding the firm, emphasizes direct access to ownership and engineering staff as a differentiator, aiming to provide personalized service that larger contract manufacturers cannot match.

Our unwavering commitment is to you, the customer concerned about the relentless rise in utility bills, fear of power outages, or seeking reliable energy solutions for remote areas. We understand that your primary concern is achieving energy independence while also being environmentally conscious. That’s why we’ve spent years perfecting our solar solutions, ensuring they are efficient and affordable. about:

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems, including grid-tie arrays, off-grid solutions, battery backup storage, electric vehicle charging stations, and generator backup. Its technicians manage the full project lifecycle—from engineering and permitting through installation and ongoing maintenance—tailoring each system to the customer’s site and energy goals.

Customers range from homeowners and small businesses seeking lower utility bills to remote cabin owners and telecommunications sites requiring reliable off-grid power. The firm has also equipped water-heating systems and provided backup generation for residential and light-commercial clients across the region.

West’s master electrician license and Missouri state electrical contractor credential underpin the company’s emphasis on code-compliant, long-lasting installations built to perform for 25 years or more. The founders say they started the business to deliver dependable energy independence—whether for daily savings or catastrophic outage resilience—backed by hands-on technical support throughout the system’s life.

The business was built on the premise that solar system owners need dedicated service technicians rather than installers who prioritize new sales. It emphasizes its BBB accreditation, state electrical and home improvement licenses in New Jersey and Pennsylvania, and over 15 years of combined industry experience among its staff to differentiate itself in the market.

name: Solar Power & Light, LLC.
old_description: Look for a proven local track record, in-house engineering, and transparent financing. SPL Solar has served Ohio and neighboring states since 2010, with 200+ MW developed and Inc. 5000 recognition — so when you search for solar companies near me, you're already in the right place.
about:
Solar Power & Light, LLC (SP&L) was founded in 2010 in Miamisburg, Ohio, as a spin-off of the Inc. 5000-recognized parent company buyCASTINGS.com, whose management team had operated in the Ohio market since 2000. The company was established by Neil Chaudhry (CEO) and Greg Akers (Business Development Executive) to pioneer Power Purchase Agreements for municipal clients, winning the City of Cincinnati’s inaugural solar RFP in 2012.

SP&L delivers full-spectrum solar services: development (site assessment, PPA contracting, land acquisition, utility interconnection), engineering-procurement-construction (EPC) through SP&L Solar Installers, LLC, asset management (performance analytics, O&M, SREC brokerage), residential solar and consumer services (installation, battery storage, backup generators, financing), and a $300M+ funding engine (SP&L Money Solutions) plus $15M+ in federal and state R&D grants. To date, the firm has originated over 200 MW of PPA contracts, constructed more than 11 MW for public entities, and manages 14+ MW across 29 sites in Ohio, Kentucky, Pennsylvania, Illinois, and Minnesota.

The company serves commercial, industrial, educational, municipal, agricultural, nonprofit, and residential customers. Reference projects include a 500 kW installation for the City of Cincinnati, 55 kW and 80 kW systems for Wangler Ace Hardware and Ace Hardware in Greenville, a 99.5 kW array for Billenstein Family Farm, a PPA for the City of Franklin’s water treatment plant, and a $1.5 million project for Ansonia Local Schools delivering over $50,000 in annual savings.

SP&L differentiates itself through its proprietary Integrated Development Teaming™ (IDT) methodology launched in 2012, distributed inverter architecture for superior low-light harvesting, automated wire-harness manufacturing adapted from automotive production, and early adoption of 1,000-volt DC design to lower balance-of-system costs. As a federal contractor leveraging shared affiliate infrastructure, the firm emphasizes enduring value, innovative technology, and efficient solutions that reduce levelized cost of energy for investors and host sites.

name: Solar Technology Alabama
old_description: Ron Holland is a graduate of Mississippi State University with a degree in electrical engineering.  He worked as a power distribution engineer for the Southern Company for 20 years before starting his own business.  His concern over grid vulnerability and interest in self-sufficiency, alternative energy, and resilient communities led him to start Solar Technology Alabama in 2008.  He built the Alabama Solar Technology Center and has lived off the grid since 2011, allowing him to learn more about independent living than can be learned any other way.  Solar Tech provides custom-designed systems and installation of off-grid and stand-alone power systems, along with an array of different services that support grid independence.
about:
Solar Technology Alabama is based in Eva, Alabama. The company was founded in 2008 by Ron Holland, a Mississippi State University electrical engineering graduate who spent 20 years as a power distribution engineer at Southern Company. His concern over grid vulnerability and interest in self‑sufficiency led him to start the business; he later built the Alabama Solar Technology Center and has lived off‑grid since 2011.

The firm designs and installs custom off‑grid and stand‑alone solar power systems, including solar water heating, solar water pumping, and battery backup systems. Services cover full installation, system sizing, permitting, plumbing adjustments, commissioning, and a paid consultation offering for system optimization. Operations span from Montgomery to southern Middle Tennessee.

Customers are homeowners, cabin owners, and businesses seeking energy independence in North Alabama. Some clients are fully off‑grid, while others keep grid connection but install off‑grid systems for essential loads. The company explicitly does not accept residential grid‑tie projects.

The company says its differentiator is firsthand off‑grid living experience since 2011, climate‑specific designs that account for Alabama’s hard freezes, and a focus on energy security through storage rather than grid cooperation. Consultation services aim to educate customers on system limits and capabilities.
